verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents Shortcuts automation and a conversational 'Repository Agent' that can browse, search, modify, commit, pull and push files, giving some non-UI control paths, but there is no evidence of a comprehensive API/URL-scheme that mirrors all UI functionality, and probes confirm no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs exist. Missing for 10: documented full API/URL-scheme coverage of all UI actions, evidence of parity for advanced git operations (rebase, LFS, submodules, signing) via API, and any independent corroboration of API completeness.
